title: Resolvable quantum Latin squares with maximal cardinality
summary: In this paper we investigate the existence of a maximal-cardinality \(t\)-resolvable quantum Latin square (\(t\text{-}\text{RQLS}(v)\)). We determine the existence of a maximal-cardinality \(1\text{-}\text{RQLS}(v)\) with \(17\) possible exceptions based on the established research result and construct a maximal-cardinality \(2\text{-}\text{RQLS}(n^2)\) for every integer \(n\geq6\).
